sources.title: roberta-large: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview roberta-large is a transformer model pretrained using masked language modeling on 160GB of English text across five datasets: BookCorpus (11,038 unpublished books), English Wikipedia, CC-News (63 million news articles from 2016-2019), OpenWebText, and Stories from CommonCrawl. sources.snippet: RoBERTa is a robustly optimized BERT encoder: more data/steps, no NSP, dynamic masking, byte-level BPE (mask token <mask>), and padding-offset position ids. For more details on the model, please go to the upstream model card. Pure- Keras 3 conversion of FacebookAI/roberta-large for zeromodels.
